messages.text: What are the most important S-parameters capabilities for applications in Aerospace / Defense?

The passages do not explicitly rank “most important” S-parameter capabilities for Aerospace / Defense, but for satellite payload and component testing they support prioritizing VNA/S-parameter capabilities around component-level measurements of converters, mixers, amplifiers, filters, antennas, group delay, phase, and noise figure.[2]
| Capability area | What matters for Aerospace / Defense satellite/component work | Evidence |
|---|---|---|

| High dynamic range and sensitivity | ZNA key performance includes dynamic range >129 dB without options, 147 dB typical with options, and maximum attainable range up to 170 dB allowing full 2-port correction; sensitivity is >–120 dBm at 1 Hz IF bandwidth without options, with –162 dBm measured with options and normalized to 1 Hz.[29] | [29] |
| Accurate magnitude and phase S-parameters | ZNA26 transmission uncertainty examples include 0.04 dB / 0.7° from >200 MHz to 10 GHz at 0 dB to –30 dB transmission, and 0.05 dB / 1.3° from >10 GHz to 26.5 GHz at 0 dB to –30 dB transmission.[15] | [15] |
| Reflection accuracy / matching performance | ZNA26 reflection uncertainty examples include 0.10 dB / 0.6° at 0 dB reflection from 10 MHz to 10 GHz, and effective system data includes directivity, source match, load match, reflection tracking, and transmission tracking after calibration.[15][48] | [15][48] |

| Pulsed S-parameter capability | R&S ZNA-K7 supports measurements on pulsed signals, and ZNA26/ZNA43 hardware options include internal pulse modulators with 40 ns nominal minimum pulse width.[72][51][56] | [72][51][56] |

【推論】For Aerospace / Defense satellite RF work, the strongest S-parameter capability set to emphasize is wide/mmWave frequency coverage, high dynamic range, calibrated magnitude/phase accuracy, group delay on frequency-converting devices, pulsed measurements, deembedding, and TVAC/remote calibration support, because the cited satellite passages connect ZNA to converters, mixers, amplifiers, filters, antennas, group delay, phase, and noise figure testing, while the ZNA passages provide the corresponding options and specifications.[2][10][29][40][72][21]

answer.question: What are the most important S-parameters capabilities for applications in Aerospace / Defense?

passages.text:
衛星酬載與元件測試 › 主要 RF 測試項目
依 [[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]]，satellite payload / components testing 主要涵蓋：

- [[衛星酬載群延遲量測]]：判定 transmission path phase distortions 與 channel band edges distortion。
- Linearity and gain transfer measurements：gain compression、AM/AM、AM/PM、ACLR、[[NPR]]、distortion。
- Signal quality measurements：modulation accuracy、[[BER]]、[[EVM]]、carrier-in-carrier interference analysis。
- [[OFDM]] signal generation and analysis：custom OFDM、DFT-s-OFDM、f-OFDM、UFMC、FBMC、GFDM。
- [[Spurious emissions]] measurements：wide frequency range、very low level spurs、narrow RBW 與 long measurement time 問題。
- [[Noise figure measurement]] and gain measurements：使用 [[R&S FS-SNS]] 或 [[R&S ZNA-K30]]。
- [[TVAC 衛星酬載測試]]：thermal vacuum chamber 下的 payload qualification 與 calibration / power measurement。
- Digital interface testing：[[SpaceWire]]、[[SpaceFibre]]、MIL-STD-1553、ARINC 429、CAN、I²C/SPI、UART 等 bus decode / trigger / debug。

衛星酬載與元件測試 › 儀器與測試角色
依 [[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]]：

- [[R&S FSW]] + [[R&S SMW200A]]：建議用於 complete payload testing，涵蓋 group delay、linearity、NPR、modulation、OFDM、spurious 與 signal quality。
- [[R&S ZNA]]：建議用於 component level testing，特別是 converters、mixers、amplifiers、filters、antennas、noise figure、group delay 與 phase measurements。
- [[R&S RTP]] 與 [[R&S RTO6]]：用於 satellite digital interface decode / trigger / debug。
- [[R&S ZN-Z33]]、[[R&S NRP33SN-V]]、[[R&S NRP67SN-V]]：用於 [[TVAC 衛星酬載測試]] 的 inline calibration 與 chamber 內 power measurement。

衛星酬載與元件測試 › 測試背景
依 [[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]]（September 2022，Version 02.00）：

- 衛星通訊系統需支援 direct broadcast、wireless communications、remote sensing，並涵蓋 commercial 與 government systems。
- 衛星系統需要 24/7 operation、multi-decade system longevity 與 satellite life cycle 期間的 quality of service。
- 現代衛星系統需相容 existing cellular networks 與 emerging wireless technologies。
- 衛星設備製造商面臨 test time / cost 降低需求，同時 uplink beams 與 downlink beams 總數增加。
- 一個 uplink digital data stream 可能對應 multiple downlink streams，因此測試方案需 straightforward、fast、reproducible，且具備 high measurement performance 與 repeatability。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 來源列出的優點
- 可在 milliseconds 內量測 wideband signals 的 absolute group delay 與 relative group delay。
- Signal averaging 與 smoothing 可改善 carrier-to-noise ratio，在 cables 與 fixtures 導致 high signal path losses 時取得 valid results。
- 可自動補償 in-orbit measurements 的 Doppler effects。
- Frequency converters 的 relative group delay 可達 1 ns measurement accuracy，且不需要 reference mixer 或 golden device。
- Non-frequency-translating measurements 的 relative group delay 可達 300 ps measurement accuracy。
- [[R&S SMW200A]] 可內部彈性產生 MCCW signals 與 modulated signals，並可設定 carrier spacing 與 number of carriers。
- Deembedding function 可修正 measurement setup 中 cables 與 fixtures 的 frequency response。
- [[R&S FSW-K17S]] option 可量測 low SNR 的 wideband signals，透過分析 overall signal 的 subspans 改善 SNR 與 measurement speeds。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 方法選擇
依 [[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]]：

- [[R&S FSW]] + [[R&S SMW200A]] 建議用於 complete payload testing。
- [[R&S ZNA]] 建議用於 component level testing。
- Spectrum analyzer + signal generator 的 measuring principle 是產生 multi-carrier signal，量測 carriers 之間的 phase shift / difference，再計算 group delay。
- VNA 的 measuring principle 是產生 two-tone signal，並在 reference 與 measurement receivers 中量測 carriers 之間的 phase。

衛星酬載群延遲量測
[[衛星酬載群延遲量測]]是用來判定 satellite communications transmission path phase distortions、frequency converter / transponder channel band edge distortion 與 transmission path quality 的測試方法集合。

R&S ZNL20 › Spectrum analysis 主要條件（摘錄）
- [[R&S ZNL20-B1]] 的 spectrum analysis frequency range 為 5 kHz to 26.5 GHz，高於 R&S®ZNL20 的 VNA frequency range 5 kHz to 20 GHz；本頁依來源分別記錄，不合併。
- R&S®ZNL20-K14 independent CW source maximum output frequency = 20 GHz。
- Second harmonics，source power –10 dBm：R&S®ZNL20，10 MHz to 13 GHz，≤ –20 dBc，typical –35 dBc。
- Third harmonics，source power –10 dBm：R&S®ZNL20，10 MHz to 8.5 GHz，≤ –25 dBc，typical –40 dBc。
- Frequency response referenced to 50 MHz，RF attenuation 0 dB/10 dB/20 dB/30 dB，+18 °C to +28 °C：10 MHz < f ≤ 2.9 GHz < 0.8 dB（σ = 0.1 dB）；2.9 GHz < f ≤ 6 GHz < 1.3 dB（σ = 0.2 dB）；6 GHz < f ≤ 14 GHz < 2.0 dB（σ = 0.5 dB）；14 GHz < f ≤ 20 GHz < 2.5 dB（σ = 0.66 dB）；20 GHz < f ≤ 26.5 GHz < 3.0 dB（σ = 0.66 dB）。
- Total measurement uncertainty 條件：signal level 0 dB to –50 dB below reference level、S/N > 20 dB、sweep time auto、sweep type sweep、RF attenuation 10 dB/20 dB/30 dB、span/RBW < 100、95 % confidence level、+18 °C to +28 °C。R&S®ZNL20：3 MHz < f ≤ 2.9 GHz 為 1 dB；2.9 GHz < f ≤ 6 GHz 為 1.5 dB；6 GHz < f ≤ 14 GHz 為 2.2 dB；14 GHz < f ≤ 20 GHz 為 2.7 dB；20 GHz < f ≤ 26.5 GHz 為 3.2 dB。

R&S ZNL20 › VNA 關鍵規格
| 項目 | R&S®ZNL20 規格 |
|---|---|
| Frequency range | 5 kHz to 20 GHz |
| Impedance | 50 Ω |
| Test port connector | 3.5 mm, male |
| Number of test ports | 2 |
| Frequency resolution | 1 Hz |
| Measurement points | 1 to 100001 per trace |
| Measurement bandwidth | 1 Hz to 500 kHz，1/1.5/2/3/5/7 sequence |
| Standard aging per year | ±1 × 10⁻⁶ |
| Aging per year with R&S®FPL1-B4 | ±1 × 10⁻⁷ |
| Standard temperature drift, +5 °C to +40 °C | ±1 × 10⁻⁶ |
| Temperature drift with R&S®FPL1-B4, +5 °C to +40 °C | ±1 × 10⁻⁸ |
| Achievable initial calibration accuracy standard | ±5 × 10⁻⁷ |
| Achievable initial calibration accuracy with R&S®FPL1-B4 | ±5 × 10⁻⁸ |
| Test port input maximum nominal input level | 0 dBm |
| Test port input damage level | +27 dBm |
| Test port input damage DC voltage | 30 V |

R&S ZNL20 › 文件與適用條件
- 相關來源：[[ZNL_specs_en_3607-1071-22_v1000]]。
- 文件：R&S®ZNL Vector Network Analyzer，PD 3607.1071.22，Version 10.00，September 2025。
- Product data 適用條件：ambient temperature 下存放 3 小時後 warm-up operation 30 分鐘；符合 specified environmental conditions；遵守 recommended calibration interval；已執行所有 applicable internal automatic adjustments。
- Recommended calibration interval：1 year。
- Data without tolerance limits is not binding；內容 subject to change。

Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200 › 關鍵實體與概念
- [[Rohde & Schwarz]]：提供 satellite payload and components test and measurement solutions。
- [[Rohde & Schwarz GmbH & Co KG]]：文件頁尾 copyright owner，© 2017–2022，地址標示 81671 Munich, Germany。
- [[R&S FSW]]：用於 group delay、linearity、NPR、signal quality、spurious、carrier-in-carrier 與 oscillator / synthesizer measurements；來源列 key features 為 up to 90 GHz、up to 500 GHz with external harmonic mixers、up to 8.3 GHz internal analysis bandwidth、800 MHz real-time analysis bandwidth。
- [[R&S SMW200A]]：用於 multi-carrier / modulated signal generation、OFDM waveform generation、DPD、NPR stimulus；來源列 key features 為 up to 67 GHz、up to 2 GHz I/Q modulation bandwidth、with [[R&S SMW-K555]] 可達 4 GHz signal bandwidth、optional second RF path up to 44 GHz。
- [[R&S ZNA]]：用於 payload components RF measurements、converter / mixer group delay、noise figure、amplifier/filter/antenna measurements；來源列 key features 包含 up to 67 GHz、up to eight independent receivers、four phase coherent sources、two internal LO sources、internal combiner。
- [[R&S FS-SNS]]：smart noise source，用於簡化 spectrum analyzer 的 noise figure and gain measurements。
- [[R&S ZN-Z33]]：TVAC-compatible automatic calibration unit，可放在 chamber 內做 inline recalibration。
- [[R&S NRP33SN-V]] 與 [[R&S NRP67SN-V]]：TVAC-designed three-path diode power sensors，分別支援 up to 33 GHz / 67 GHz。
- [[R&S RTP]]、[[R&S RTO6]]：oscilloscopes，用於 satellite digital interface trigger、decode 與 debug。
- [[衛星酬載與元件測試]]：本來源的總題目。
- [[衛星酬載群延遲量測]]：比較 spectrum analyzer + signal generator 與 VNA two-tone technique 的測試主題。
- [[TVAC 衛星酬載測試]]：thermal vacuum chamber 下 satellite payload qualification 測試主題。
- [[Noise figure measurement]]、[[Group delay]]、[[NPR]]、[[EVM]]、[[OFDM]]、[[Spurious emissions]]、[[SpaceWire]]、[[SpaceFibre]]。

Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200 › 重點摘要
這份來源是 Rohde & Schwarz application brochure《Satellite payload and components testing》，文件代碼 `PD 5215.2120.92`，Version 02.00，文件日期標示 `September 2022 (ch)`，主題是使用 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 儀器測試 [[衛星酬載與元件測試]]、transponders、modules 與 components。

- 衛星通訊系統支援 direct broadcast、wireless communications、remote sensing，涵蓋 commercial 與 government systems，並要求 24/7 reliable operation 與 multi-decade system longevity。
- 來源將 payload 技術演進描述為從 bent-pipe 或 digital transparent payloads 進展到 digital regenerative payloads；regenerative payloads 增加 system capacity 與 flexibility，但也增加 testing complexity。
- Bent-pipe payload channel 高階組成包含 uplink antenna、low noise amplifier、filter、frequency converter、filter、high power amplifier、filter、downlink antenna 與 local oscillator。
- Regenerative payload channel 在 RF chain 中加入 digital demodulator、baseband processing and switching、digital modulator 等功能區塊。
- 來源定位 [[R&S FSW]]、[[R&S SMW200A]] 與 [[R&S ZNA]] 為 satellite payload / component RF testing 的核心儀器：[[R&S FSW]] + [[R&S SMW200A]] 偏 complete payload testing，[[R&S ZNA]] 偏 component level testing。
- [[衛星酬載群延遲量測]] 是主要測試主題之一；來源比較 multi-carrier group delay measurement 與 [[R&S ZNA]] two-tone technique。
- Linearity and gain transfer measurements 涵蓋 gain compression、AM/AM、AM/PM、NPR、ACLR、DPD 與 EVM 等 payload / component characterization。
- [[TVAC 衛星酬載測試]] 使用 chamber 外部測試儀器、長 cables、inline calibration modules 與 TVAC-compatible power sensors，以處理 temperature drift 與 vacuum 下無法人工進入 chamber 的 calibration 問題。
- Digital interface testing 涵蓋 [[SpaceWire]]、8b/10b-based [[SpaceFibre]]、MIL-STD-1553、ARINC 429、CAN、I²C/SPI、UART 等 bus trigger/decode/debug 測試。

Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200 › 與既有知識的關係
- 本來源補強 [[R&S FSW]]、[[R&S SMW200A]]、[[R&S ZNA]] 在 satellite payload / component testing 的 application-level 用途；既有產品頁主要保存 datasheet / specifications 層級資料，本來源屬應用方案與測試方法說明。
- 本來源中 [[R&S SMW200A]] 的 up to 67 GHz、2 GHz I/Q modulation bandwidth、[[R&S SMW-K555]] 4 GHz signal bandwidth 與既有 [[R&S SMW200A]] 規格頁相容。
- 本來源中 [[R&S FSW]] 的 up to 90 GHz、up to 500 GHz with external harmonic mixers、8.3 GHz internal analysis bandwidth 與既有 [[R&S FSW]] 頁的 frequency extension / bandwidth options 相容。
- 本來源中 [[R&S ZNA]] 的 converter / mixer、group delay、noise figure、antenna、amplifier、filter measurement use cases，補足既有 [[R&S ZNA]] 規格頁的 application context。
- 本來源可連到既有太空與衛星主題，如 [[台灣太空產業]]、[[衛星地面設備]]、[[On-Board Computer]]、[[PCDU]]，但本來源不是市場供應鏈名單，也不提供台灣公司資料。

R&S ZNA26 › Software options
[[R&S ZNA26]] 可使用 [[R&S ZNA]] 系列 software / measurement options，例如 [[R&S ZNA-K1]] spectrum analyzer mode、[[R&S ZNA-K6]] phase coherent source control、[[R&S ZNA-K7]] measurements on pulsed signals、[[R&S ZNA-K8]] mmWave converter support、[[R&S ZNA-K9]] group delay measurements、[[R&S ZNA-K30]] noise figure measurement、[[R&S ZNA-K980]] HUMS。各 option 的 order no. 與相依關係見 [[R&S ZNA]]。

R&S ZNA26 › 基本規格
- Frequency range：10 MHz to 26.5 GHz。
- Test port connector：3.5 mm, male, ruggedized。
- Number of test ports：2 or 4。
- Impedance：50 Ω。
- DC block：standard。
- Frequency resolution：1 Hz。
- Number of measurement points per trace：1 to 100001。
- Measurement bandwidth：base unit 1 Hz to 1.5 MHz；with [[R&S ZNA-K17]] increased IF bandwidth 30 MHz option 時為 1 Hz to 30 MHz。

R&S ZNA26 › Measurement accuracy 條件與摘錄
R&S®ZNA26 measurement accuracy 的有效條件：+18 °C to +28 °C；calibration 後溫度變化不超過 1 °C；使用 R&S®ZN-Z235 calibration kit；frequency points、measurement bandwidth、sweep time 必須與 measurement 和 calibration 相同；不使用 interpolation of the calibration；base unit without options 條件為 measurement bandwidth 10 Hz、nominal source power 0 dBm。

| 10 MHz to 40 MHz | –50 dB to –60 dB | 4.50 dB、25.0° |
| > 40 MHz to 200 MHz | 0 dB to –30 dB | 0.04 dB、0.5° |
| > 40 MHz to 200 MHz | –50 dB to –60 dB | 0.45 dB、3.0° |

| > 200 MHz to 10 GHz | –50 dB to –60 dB | 0.09 dB、1.0° |

| > 10 GHz to 26.5 GHz | –50 dB to –60 dB | 0.13 dB、1.5° |

| > 20 GHz to 26.5 GHz | –35 dB reflection | 3.21 dB、26.0° |

R&S ZNA43 › Software options
[[R&S ZNA43]] 可使用 [[R&S ZNA]] 系列 software / measurement options，例如 [[R&S ZNA-K1]] spectrum analyzer mode、[[R&S ZNA-K6]] phase coherent source control、[[R&S ZNA-K7]] measurements on pulsed signals、[[R&S ZNA-K8]] mmWave converter support、[[R&S ZNA-K9]] group delay measurements、[[R&S ZNA-K30]] noise figure measurement、[[R&S ZNA-K980]] HUMS。各 option 的 order no. 與相依關係見 [[R&S ZNA]]。

R&S ZNA43 › Measurement accuracy 條件與摘錄
R&S®ZNA43 measurement accuracy 的共通有效條件：+18 °C to +28 °C；calibration 後溫度變化不超過 1 °C；frequency points、measurement bandwidth、sweep time 必須與 measurement 和 calibration 相同；不使用 interpolation of the calibration；base unit without options 條件為 measurement bandwidth 10 Hz、nominal source power 0 dBm。

R&S ZNA43 › 基本規格
- Frequency range：10 MHz to 43.5 GHz。
- Test port connector：2.4 mm, male, ruggedized 或 2.92 mm, male, ruggedized。
- Number of test ports：2 or 4。
- Impedance：50 Ω。
- DC block：standard。
- Frequency resolution：1 Hz。
- Number of measurement points per trace：1 to 100001。
- Measurement bandwidth：base unit 1 Hz to 1.5 MHz；with [[R&S ZNA-K17]] increased IF bandwidth 30 MHz option 時為 1 Hz to 30 MHz。

R&S ZN-Z33 › 來源中的定位
依 [[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]]（September 2022，Version 02.00）：

- [[R&S ZN-Z33]] automatic calibration units（model .03）設計為可在 [[TVAC 衛星酬載測試]] 中運作。
- [[R&S ZN-Z33]] 可永久連接於 test setup cables 與 DUT 之間，以便必要時 recalibration。
- Environmental conditions 下，只需一次 basic multiport calibration with through connections。
- Vacuum conditions 下的 temperature runs 中，inline calibration units 支援在 DUT in place 時進行 remote controlled re-calibration。
- [[R&S ZN-Z33]] 透過 CAN bus 連接至 [[R&S ZN-Z30]] controller。
- [[R&S ZN-Z30]] CAN bus network 與 [[R&S ZN-Z32]]、[[R&S ZN-Z33]] calibration units 的控制整合於 [[R&S ZNA]] firmware。
- 來源稱此控制也整合於 [[R&S SMARTerCal]] concept，可 seamless remote control calibration 與 in situ re-calibration。

R&S ZN-Z33 › 使用限制
- 來源未提供完整 datasheet、order number、connector type、port count、calibration standard details、vacuum level、qualification report 或 uncertainty budget。
- `model .03` 是來源明示資訊；不可推論其他 model 也可 TVAC。
- 本頁為 application brochure 層級資訊，不可取代 [[R&S ZNA]] 或 [[R&S ZN-Z33]] 正式附件規格書。

R&S ZN-Z33
[[R&S ZN-Z33]] 是 [[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]] 中列出的 TVAC-compatible automatic calibration unit，可放在 thermal vacuum chamber 內進行 satellite payload test setup 的 inline recalibration。

SatelliteEcoChain › 關鍵實體與概念
- [[台灣衛星產業鏈 R&S solution mapping]] — 本來源最直接支撐的概念頁，整理 satellite eco-chain 表格分類、企業列名、R&S solution mapping 與使用限制。

- [[衛星酬載與元件測試]]、[[衛星酬載群延遲量測]]、[[TVAC 衛星酬載測試]] — 表格中的 G/T、NPR、Group delay、DVB-S2/S2X 與 R&S 儀器 mapping 可連到既有衛星測試主題。

- Specifications with limits：表示 warranted product performance；以 <、≤、>、≥、±、maximum、limit of、minimum 等符號標示；compliance 由 testing 確保或由 design 推導。
- Non-traceable specifications with limits（n. trc.）：依 specifications with limits 指定與測試，但因缺乏可追溯至 national metrology standards 的 measuring equipment，product performance 不保證。
- Specifications without limits：表示 warranted product performance；未特別標記時表示數值沒有或只有可忽略偏差。
- Typical data（typ.）：representative information；若標示 <、> 或 range，代表約 80% instruments 在 production time 可達成的 performance，其他情況代表 mean value。
- Nominal values（nom.）：representative value；production 期間不測試該 parameter。
- Measured values（meas.）：individual samples 的 measurement results。
- Uncertainties：coverage factor 2，依 Guide to the Expression of Uncertainty in Measurement（GUM），並考量 environmental conditions、aging、wear and tear。
- 來源明確說明：non-traceable specifications with limits、typical data、nominal values、measured values 不由 Rohde & Schwarz 保證。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 測量原理
- [[R&S SMW200A]] 產生 multi-carrier continuous wave signal 作為 stimulus。
- Multi-carrier stimulus 的 tones 數量與 spacing / aperture 可依 DUT 需求調整。
- [[R&S FSW]] 的 group delay measurement 分兩步：
  - Reference calibration：generator 直接連接 analyzer，analyzer 判定 individual carriers 的 reference phase 與 amplitude。
  - Group delay and gain measurement：連接 DUT，analyzer 由 reference signal 與 DUT output multicarrier signal 的 phase difference 判定 carrier frequency range 的 group delay。
- 來源列出使用 [[R&S SMW-K61]] 與 [[R&S FSW-K17]] multicarrier group delay measurement application。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 來源列出的適用性與優點
- 適合 unstable LOs 的 frequency converting DUTs，因 DUT internal LO 的 frequency 與 phase deviations 可落在 IF bandwidth 範圍內，最高到 several MHz。
- New internal combiner 可簡化 measurement setup，兩個 signals 不再需要 external connection。
- Two-port [[R&S ZNA]] 搭配 optional second source，可量測 embedded LO converter group delay 與 intermodulation。
- [[R&S ZNA]] 的 two independent LOs for internal receivers 可讓 mixers 的 RF/IF 同時量測。
- Measurement speeds 為 single LO 的兩倍，並降低 conversion loss 與 group delay measurements 的 trace noise。
- 除 group delay 外，也可透過 integrating group delay 計算 relative phase 與 deviation from linear phase。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 測量原理
- [[R&S ZNA]] 使用 two-tone stimulus signal。
- 儀器量測 DUT input 與 output 的兩個 signals 之 phase difference。
- Group delay 由 phase difference 與 frequency offset 計算。
- 兩個 signals 間的 frequency offset Δf 是 aperture。
- [[R&S ZNA]] 具備用於量測不同 frequency signals 之 phase 的 frontend。
- Calibration 只需要 unknown through mixer。

The passages do not explicitly rank “most important” S-parameter capabilities for Aerospace / Defense, but for satellite payload and component testing they support prioritizing VNA/S-parameter capabilities around component-level measurements of converters, mixers, amplifiers, filters, antennas, group delay, phase, and noise figure.[2]
| Capability area | What matters for Aerospace / Defense satellite/component work | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Wide frequency coverage / mmWave readiness | R&S ZNA is positioned for payload component RF measurements, and the ZNA family covers 10 MHz up to 67 GHz, while ZNA67EXT extends a ZNA67-based system to 110 GHz.[10][71][73][33] | [10][71][73][33] |
| High dynamic range and sensitivity | ZNA key performance includes dynamic range >129 dB without options, 147 dB typical with options, and maximum attainable range up to 170 dB allowing full 2-port correction; sensitivity is >–120 dBm at 1 Hz IF bandwidth without options, with –162 dBm measured with options and normalized to 1 Hz.[29] | [29] |
| Accurate magnitude and phase S-parameters | ZNA26 transmission uncertainty examples include 0.04 dB / 0.7° from >200 MHz to 10 GHz at 0 dB to –30 dB transmission, and 0.05 dB / 1.3° from >10 GHz to 26.5 GHz at 0 dB to –30 dB transmission.[15] | [15] |
| Reflection accuracy / matching performance | ZNA26 reflection uncertainty examples include 0.10 dB / 0.6° at 0 dB reflection from 10 MHz to 10 GHz, and effective system data includes directivity, source match, load match, reflection tracking, and transmission tracking after calibration.[15][48] | [15][48] |
| Group delay and phase distortion measurement | Satellite group delay measurement is used to determine satellite communications transmission-path phase distortions, frequency converter/transponder channel band-edge distortion, and transmission-path quality.[6] | [6] |
| Frequency-converting DUT and converter/mixer support | R&S ZNA is recommended for component-level testing, especially converters, mixers, amplifiers, filters, antennas, noise figure, group delay, and phase measurements.[2] | [2] |
| Two-tone group delay on converters | R&S ZNA uses a two-tone stimulus, measures the phase difference of the DUT input and output tones, and calculates group delay from phase difference and frequency offset; calibration only requires an unknown through mixer.[40] | [40] |
| Group delay option for converters without LO access | R&S ZNA-K9 is listed as “Group delay measurements on frequency converters without LO access,” with recommended 2-port and 4-port setups documented for ZNA.[72][70] | [72][70] |
| Mixer / frequency-converting measurement options | ZNA software options include R&S ZNA-K4 scalar mixer measurements, R&S ZNA-K5 vector mixer measurements, R&S ZNA-K6 phase coherent source control, and R&S ZNA-K8 mmWave converter support.[72] | [72] |
| Multi-source / multi-receiver architecture | The ZNA is described with up to eight independent receivers, four phase-coherent sources, two internal LO sources, and an internal combiner.[10] | [10] |
| Pulsed S-parameter capability | R&S ZNA-K7 supports measurements on pulsed signals, and ZNA26/ZNA43 hardware options include internal pulse modulators with 40 ns nominal minimum pulse width.[72][51][56] | [72][51][56] |
| Noise figure plus gain characterization | Satellite payload/component RF testing includes noise figure and gain measurements, and R&S ZNA-K30 is listed as a noise figure measurement option.[1][72] | [1][72] |
| Fast sweeps and high throughput | ZNA measurement speed examples include 1 µs acquisition time per point at 1 MHz measurement bandwidth, 32 ns at 30 MHz measurement bandwidth, and a 96 ms nominal sweep from 10 MHz to 43.5 GHz with 1601 points and 2-port calibration at 500 kHz measurement bandwidth.[28][29] | [28][29] |
| Deembedding / fixture and cable correction | The satellite group delay source lists a deembedding function to correct the frequency response of cables and fixtures in the measurement setup, and ZNA options include EaZy deembedding, in-situ deembedding, smart fixture deembedding, and Delta-L PCB characterization.[4][27] | [4][27] |
| TVAC / remote calibration support | TVAC satellite payload testing uses inline calibration and chamber-internal power measurement, and the R&S ZN-Z33 is described as a TVAC-compatible automatic calibration unit for inline recalibration in satellite payload test setups.[2][21] | [2][21] |
| Time-domain / TDR capability from S-parameters | ZNA software options include R&S ZNA-K2 time domain analysis and R&S ZNA-K20 extended time domain analysis including eye diagram.[72] | [72] |
【推論】For Aerospace / Defense satellite RF work, the strongest S-parameter capability set to emphasize is wide/mmWave frequency coverage, high dynamic range, calibrated magnitude/phase accuracy, group delay on frequency-converting devices, pulsed measurements, deembedding, and TVAC/remote calibration support, because the cited satellite passages connect ZNA to converters, mixers, amplifiers, filters, antennas, group delay, phase, and noise figure testing, while the ZNA passages provide the corresponding options and specifications.[2][10][29][40][72][21]

衛星酬載與元件測試 › 主要 RF 測試項目
依 [[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]]，satellite payload / components testing 主要涵蓋：

- [[衛星酬載群延遲量測]]：判定 transmission path phase distortions 與 channel band edges distortion。
- Linearity and gain transfer measurements：gain compression、AM/AM、AM/PM、ACLR、[[NPR]]、distortion。
- Signal quality measurements：modulation accuracy、[[BER]]、[[EVM]]、carrier-in-carrier interference analysis。
- [[OFDM]] signal generation and analysis：custom OFDM、DFT-s-OFDM、f-OFDM、UFMC、FBMC、GFDM。
- [[Spurious emissions]] measurements：wide frequency range、very low level spurs、narrow RBW 與 long measurement time 問題。
- [[Noise figure measurement]] and gain measurements：使用 [[R&S FS-SNS]] 或 [[R&S ZNA-K30]]。
- [[TVAC 衛星酬載測試]]：thermal vacuum chamber 下的 payload qualification 與 calibration / power measurement。
- Digital interface testing：[[SpaceWire]]、[[SpaceFibre]]、MIL-STD-1553、ARINC 429、CAN、I²C/SPI、UART 等 bus decode / trigger / debug。

衛星酬載與元件測試 › 儀器與測試角色
依 [[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]]：

- [[R&S FSW]] + [[R&S SMW200A]]：建議用於 complete payload testing，涵蓋 group delay、linearity、NPR、modulation、OFDM、spurious 與 signal quality。
- [[R&S ZNA]]：建議用於 component level testing，特別是 converters、mixers、amplifiers、filters、antennas、noise figure、group delay 與 phase measurements。
- [[R&S RTP]] 與 [[R&S RTO6]]：用於 satellite digital interface decode / trigger / debug。
- [[R&S ZN-Z33]]、[[R&S NRP33SN-V]]、[[R&S NRP67SN-V]]：用於 [[TVAC 衛星酬載測試]] 的 inline calibration 與 chamber 內 power measurement。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 來源列出的優點
- 可在 milliseconds 內量測 wideband signals 的 absolute group delay 與 relative group delay。
- Signal averaging 與 smoothing 可改善 carrier-to-noise ratio，在 cables 與 fixtures 導致 high signal path losses 時取得 valid results。
- 可自動補償 in-orbit measurements 的 Doppler effects。
- Frequency converters 的 relative group delay 可達 1 ns measurement accuracy，且不需要 reference mixer 或 golden device。
- Non-frequency-translating measurements 的 relative group delay 可達 300 ps measurement accuracy。
- [[R&S SMW200A]] 可內部彈性產生 MCCW signals 與 modulated signals，並可設定 carrier spacing 與 number of carriers。
- Deembedding function 可修正 measurement setup 中 cables 與 fixtures 的 frequency response。
